Title:STREET LIGHTS AT 11th AND 12th m.s. WOODLANDS ROAD
MPs Speaking:Mr Ong Lian Teng; Mr A. P. Rajah (Mr Speaker);


Column: 278



    The following Questions stood in the name of Mr Ong Lian Teng ---
STREET LIGHTS AT 11th AND 12th m.s. WOODLANDS ROAD


    17. To ask the Minister for Law and National Development when the Government will install street lights at the 11th and 12th milestones, Woodlands Road.
RURAL DEVELOPMENT IN BUKIT PANJANG CONSTITUENCY


    18. To ask the Minister for Law and National Development what is the sum of money spent by the Government for rural development in the Bukit Panjang Constituency from 1st January, 1964, to 31st December, 1964, and the details of such expenditure.

T.O.L. FEES OF CROWN LAND



    19. To ask the Minister for Law and National Development whether Temporary Occupation Licence fees of Crown Land in the Mandai area have been increased and by what percentage.

    Mr Speaker: Mr Ong Lian Teng.

    There being no response, Mr E. W. Barker handed in to the Clerk written answers to Questions Nos. 17, 18 and 19.
